correctness.rationale: The exact 24-vertex 36-edge (12,7,-7) LCF graph and independent-set recursion were inspected. Fresh exhaustive independent-set generation gave size vector (1,24,240,1304,4212,8328,10024,7072,2668,424,8), proving alpha=10. All legal moves on the 424 nine-sets and eight ten-sets were reconstructed from symmetric differences and checked with all-pairs BFS: TJ_9 has 1428 edges, one 424-component and eccentricity counts 9:32,10:368,11:24; TS_9 has 1068 edges, components 416+2+2+2+2; at ten both move models have two four-cycles and eight edges. The enumeration domain and adjacency definition are exhaustive, not sampled.

evidence: The claw-free reconfiguration connectivity results exclude the McGee graph, which has induced claws; the McGee independence-complex theorem concerns topology, not token-move paths.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither broader result dominates the detailed reconfiguration metrics; topology and configuration graph connectivity are distinct invariants.
